name: Video Player
short_description: Plays MJPEG video (AVI or raw) with sound
long_description: Plays MJPEG video at its recorded frame rate in a dedicated decode-and-present loop: read, decode, present, pace, dropping frames to keep real time. Frames are shown 1:1, never scaled. Opens .avi files with the sound inside (MJPEG video plus 8/16-bit PCM or IMA ADPCM audio) and raw .mjpeg/.mjpg streams with an optional WAV sidecar of the same name. Tap the picture to pause and play; a control bar appears with a scrub bar for jumping anywhere in the clip, with <<, >> (fifteen seconds), restart and close, and hides again after three seconds. The A button pauses, B/Y seek and X leaves. Pick one clip, several, or a whole folder: a folder plays every clip in it in name order, so the picker doubles as a playlist. Picking a clip from the SD card is one tap, and an unsupported container or codec says which one it is instead of failing silently. Launching without a clip opens the file picker; the benchmark buttons measure the panel's frame rate.
